finding: The Card Database Search button has a verified local orange background, but this does not establish the Pokémon TCG site's global primary CTA color.
missingComparison: The canonical Pokémon TCG home page CTA role and its states were not compared before local color was applied to a host-search trial.
invalidInference: Database Search orange is the brand-wide CTA token.
safeConclusion: The value is at most a Card Database Search control observation until cross-page role comparison and approval.

sameCaseFollowUp.observedChange: Three TCG core pages yielded a black/white interface-action treatment candidate; one representative painted control per page now has URL, selector, region, default-state background and foreground. The 28-control frequency remains an aggregate, not 28 individual proofs.
sameCaseFollowUp.decision: Use black fill and white text only as a reversible light-surface trial value read from versioned Interpreter intent; keep global primary-action token unmapped.

consequence: The H5 trial made only small control changes and failed to establish meaningful brand expression.
